text:
Sara (growth): Heads-up — I pushed a small draft to the pricing page PR: updated FAQ around billing proration and added a micro calculator that estimates monthly spend based on qps + seq len. want quick eyes before I ship a canary to 10% traffic. TL;DR: FAQ clarifies trial vs commit, and calculator uses tokens/sec x minutes/day.
Tom (content): on it. can you paste the FAQ snippet here so I can sanity-check the voice? :eyes:
Sara (growth): sure — 
`Q: How does commitment billing work? A: Commitments are billed monthly based on reserved capacity. You can convert unused reserved capacity into credits for the next month; no auto-renew unless you opt in.`
Tom (content): language feels a bit legal — maybe swap "convert" -> "roll over" and add one short example line: "e.g., 50% unused reserved capacity becomes credits worth X".
Ellie (product): for the calculator, can we add an option for "bursting"? a lot of customers ask whether they'd pay for short spikes. If not easy, add a small note under the calculator: "bursts may incur overage charges".
Kenji (ops): we can surface overage estimate. The calculator can accept a burst multiplier and show estimated overage cost. I'll add a routing tag to leads from canary: `lead_source=pricing_canary_v1`.
Rebecca (sales): please include a new lead routing rule in HubSpot — anything with `pricing_canary_v1` and ARR > $50k -> AE queue EMEA. low effort but reduces noise.
Sara (growth): good call. plan: 1) update FAQ text per Tom, 2) add burst toggle + overage calc (Kenji), 3) add lead tag in canary and HubSpot routing (Kenji & Rebecca), 4) ship canary 10% for 48h, then run A/B with alt tier names for 2 weeks.
Tom (content): alt tier names suggestion: "Starter" -> "Launch", "Team" -> "Scale", "Enterprise" -> "Partner". shorter microcopy to test.
Ellie (product): prefer avoiding "Partner" for Enterprise; customers interpret differently. suggestion: "Launch / Growth / Enterprise+". also capture metrics: CTR to contact form, calculator completion rate, and MQL conversion.
Rebecca (sales): add one more metric: inbound quality score from HubSpot (deal create rate). will follow up with mapping.
marketing-bot: Reminder: pricing-page-canary job scheduled at 2025-08-12T16:30Z.
Kenji (ops): config snippet for HubSpot webhook routing (pseudo):
```
if lead.tags contains "pricing_canary_v1":
  if lead.estimated_arr > 50000:
    assign -> AE_EMEA
  else:
    assign -> growth_inbound_queue
```
Kenji (ops): I'll create the webhook and add a filter in Segment. Also adding a GA event `pricing_calculator_complete` so we can A/B analyze via Looker.
Sara (growth): timeline: try to get copy + calc done today, Kenji to add webhooks by EOD, deploy canary tomorrow morning. Rebecca — can you pre-alert AEs so they don't miss high-quality leads?
Rebecca (sales): yes, I'll ping the EMEA AEs and add a short playbook in the AE Slack channel.
Tom (content): I pushed the voice edits and an extra FAQ example. quick review appreciated. :thumbsup:
Ellie (product): quick note — for the A/B we'll randomize tier names client-side and tag with `tier_name_variant=A|B`. make sure HubSpot mapping preserves that tag for downstream analysis.
Sara (growth): perfect. after the 48h canary we look at calculator completion + contact CTR. if positive, escalate to 50% and start the two-week alt-tier test.
Kenji (ops): deployed canary job to staging. I'll roll tomorrow 09:00 UTC unless someone objects.
Tom (content): no objections. good luck team! :rocket:
